reviews.title: S-tier build quality!
reviews.comment:
After doing tons of research and watching a hundred different videos reviewing cases i decided to go with the Montech King 95 Pro. This would be my 1st official build by myself. First off, i have to say, this case is HEAVY. It will take up a quarter of your desk space, which i ended up using a 2nd desk to set it on, as to keep all of my desk real estate intact.
This case is beautiful, and even though it was my 1st build , the case was incredibly easy to build in. All the sides come off, and everything opens up. It gives you quite a few ways to set things up depending on what youre wanting to do. The openings found throughout the inside provide easy access for cable management
All of the accessories Montech includes are awesome and helpful during the build process. The included fan controller works great, LED's look amazing, and my CPU and GPU temps are great as well.
All in all, i would definitely recommend this case. Its built exceptionally well, its solid as a rock and does not feel cheap whatsoever.
reviews.author: Richie Caldwell

reviews.title: Designed for builders
reviews.comment:
This is the 3rd PC I’ve built, prior to this build I used Thermaltake Cases, and I was able almost immediately notice when building this PC how much better this case is manufactured. One important thing that needs to be addressed is that the case states that it can accommodate a 360mm radiator in the top section. Well that’s true, but close to not being so. Depends ultimately on which radiator you select. I installed a PrimoChill 360SL Eximo for the radiator, and it barely fits. (10mm of free play +/-) I had to install low profile plug fittings from Barrow to accommodate the lack of space on the two terminals not being used for this build.
With that out of the way,
The case fits new Megatron-sized GPUs.
Comes with 6 Argb case fans.
Generous cable management room.
Beautiful showcase glass.
Modular staging bracket for the Two 140mm fans.
Mounting adapters & Modules + various locations hardest on the case for HDDs (2.5 & 3.5).
Excellent Price/value.
And just so many things I see that really shows the design team really put their heads together when it came to making this case. I would highly recommend this case for newcomers building PCs and seasoned builders alike.
1 other con besides the radiator accommodation on top is the belly screen on the bottom is kinda cheap/ flimsy. Would swap it for a magnet style like I’ve seen on some other cases if possible.
With all that said I still give it 5/5. It’s been a blast building this PC. Time to see how many instances of Windows Solitaire I can open at once before crashing it.
reviews.author: Alexander

reviews.title: Very good value for a dual chamber PC case
reviews.comment:
I got the King 95 pro, with the preinstalled fans. The ability to remove the top, front, and both sides easily made it a dream to build in. So easy to get to everything. All the extra space made cable management very easy, and you could say not even really needed. The included ARGB fan hub works well also. It did take a me a few days, however, to figure out how to use it. I had to RTM that one. There is a button on the front, which you can press to change the built in ARGB effects, or you can hold it for 3 seconds to switch it over to being controlled by the onboard mobo ARGB headers. The air flow is good, and so are the temps, without being loud. The 3 bottom fans blowing on the GPU help a bunch with keeping the temps pretty low, even when it's over clocked.
All in all, this case is by far the easiest to build in that I've ever had, and I have built well over a hundred PCs. The dual chamber design is the biggest reason. imho
